trait.ethermod.tectonic.momentum.desc: Mining builds [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color]; each stage mines faster.
trait.ethermod.tectonic.steady_hand.desc: Held blocks lock to the grid, preview where they land and are set down exactly as shown.
trait.ethermod.tectonic.common_collector: Drops from blocks you break fly to you.
trait.ethermod.tectonic.vein_miner.desc: Mine whole ore veins at once. See nearby ores through walls.
trait.ethermod.tectonic.mass_pickup.desc: Lift a whole group of blocks at once.
trait.ethermod.plasmic.lock_on.desc: [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color] locks your beam onto its target.
trait.ethermod.plasmic.arc.desc: [color=#E99F20]Pressure[/color] chains your beam to nearby enemies.
trait.ethermod.plasmic.disrupt.desc: Sustained contact weakens armour and disables shields.
trait.ethermod.kinetic.marksman.desc: Stand still while charging for faster shots.
trait.ethermod.kinetic.detonator.desc: Press the same button again to burst your projectile.
trait.ethermod.kinetic.seeker.desc: Projectiles home in on the enemy you aimed near.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#2074E9]Hydraulic Mode[/color]: aim-steered water blob (left click) and ice shard (right click). Swim faster.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.pressure.desc: Water placed against a block stays as a source.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.glacier.desc: Frost bridges are 3 blocks wide and last 3x longer.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.rapids.desc: Water shots over water raise a surge 2/4/6 wide that carries boats and creatures.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.common_slipstre: Water and Frost shots lose no range underwater.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.tidecaller.desc: Ride a fully charged Water shot.
trait.ethermod.hydraulic.diving_bell.des: Water and Frost shots carve air tunnels through water.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#E95C20]Pyrotechnic Mode[/color]: molten glob (left click), fire seed (right click). Immune to fire and lava. Ignite shots fuel furnaces.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.inferno.desc: Lava placed against a block stays as a source. Elsewhere it cools after 8s.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.wildfire.desc: Your fire spreads through flammable terrain.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.flashover.des: Hitting a burning enemy ignites those nearby.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.phoenix.desc: Survive a fatal hit in a burst of fire. Once every 10 min.
trait.ethermod.pyrotechnic.soulwake.desc: Your burns become soulfire. Enemies it kills rise as an allied Soulfire Blazeling.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#20E9C1]Gust Mode[/color]: push things away. Shots recoil; slammed mobs take damage. Double jump. Stasis Grenade: what it sticks to is held, then takes all its stored knockback at once.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.gale_force.desc: Gust hits a wider area. Hit enemies take more fall damage.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.common_featherf: No fall damage. Hold Jump to fall slowly. Charging a weapon in the air slows your fall even more.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.bunny_hop.desc: Jump right as you land to build speed. Hold Jump to keep hopping.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.ground_slam.des: Sneak to charge a jump. Sneak in the air to slam down, harder the further you fell.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.common_air_cont: Better steering in the air, without braking.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.cyclone.desc: A full-charge Gust becomes a slow whirlwind that lifts mobs and items for 3s, then bursts.
trait.ethermod.pneumatic.rebound.desc: Gusted enemies bounce off walls and each other.
trait.ethermod.photonic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#E9C820]Light Mode[/color]. You glow, lighting nearby players too. Light shots bounce twice, leaving a light at each bounce.
trait.ethermod.photonic.flare.desc: Light projectiles reveal nearby entities through walls.
trait.ethermod.photonic.radiance.desc: Light shots heal you and nearby allies (doesn't stack).
trait.ethermod.photonic.common_lumen_tra: Sneak to see the path you walked.
trait.ethermod.photonic.daybreak.desc: Light shots scare darkness-loving mobs and burn them up close.
trait.ethermod.photonic.mirage.desc: Light shots leave a decoy of you where they end.
trait.ethermod.photonic.common_clear_sig: Night Vision. Immune to Blindness and Darkness.
trait.ethermod.photonic.constellation.de: Bounce lights link up, spreading their effects. Mirage leaves a decoy at each.
trait.ethermod.photonic.supernova.desc: The last impact releases one big Light pulse. Mirage decoys last longer.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#9520E9]Tether Mode[/color]: left click hooks, right click reels (tap: all the way, hold: while held). Jump to let go at speed. Move 10% faster.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.blink.desc: Double-tap right click while hooked to teleport to the hook.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.gravity_shift.de: Double-tap right click while hooked to make that surface your floor.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.skyhook.desc: Tether shots that miss anchor in empty air.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.zipline.desc: Sneak while hooking two surfaces to link them with a rope. Aim at it and hold right click to ride it.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.gravity_skate.de: Running builds to twice sprint speed. Swings and flings carry into the run.
trait.ethermod.gravitic.airwalk.desc: Walk off a ledge onto a glass floor. Jump drops it; tap Sneak to step down, hold to fall.
trait.ethermod.botanic.badge.desc: Unlocks [color=#31E920]Growth Mode[/color]. Harvest ripe crops 3x3; pollen grows plants and poisons foes. Sneak-Beam tills. Farmland is never trampled.
trait.ethermod.botanic.overgrowth.desc: Harvests spread to all connected ripe crops of the same kind.
trait.ethermod.botanic.herder.desc: Sneak-Beam feeds animals from your inventory.
trait.ethermod.botanic.cross_pollination: Harvesting grows nearby young crops a stage.
